title: Required Phase 2 artifacts exist
expected: Every file in handoff index exists and opens.

title: V3.2 remains untouched
expected: No Phase 2 artifact silently modifies original V3.2 source.

title: Phase boundary is explicit
expected: Docs identify Phase 3+ behavior as future/deferred, not implemented.

title: Screen IDs unique
expected: All learner/staff screen IDs are unique and traceable.

title: Routes documented
expected: Every inventory screen has a route or overlay identity.

title: PRD traceability complete
expected: PRD-01..PRD-16 all map to UX surfaces and QA cases.

title: Locked vs hypothesis language
expected: 5m/retry/replay/placement thresholds are labelled hypotheses where applicable.

title: No false learning claims
expected: No precise mastery/diagnosis/efficacy claim appears in learner copy.

title: No credential material
expected: No password/token/secret URL in Phase 2 package.

title: Prototype is self-contained
expected: No external CDN/network dependency is required to render prototype.

title: Learner top-level IA
expected: Bottom navigation exposes only Home, Learn, Course, Profile.

title: Onboarding outside main shell
expected: Main bottom navigation is absent until main shell.

title: Home purpose
expected: Primary next action, reason and approximate duration are understandable.

title: Learn purpose
expected: Finite cycle start/resume is prominent; no endless-feed affordance.

title: Course purpose
expected: Open/current/due/locked/preview states are distinguishable.

title: Profile purpose
expected: Goal, qualitative evidence and settings are separated from mastery claims.

title: Staff IA
expected: Sidebar has Dashboard, Learners, Content, Interventions, Analytics, Administration.

title: Publishing nested in Content
expected: Publishing states are within Content lifecycle, not separate top-level product domain.

title: Role visibility disclaimer
expected: Docs state menu visibility is not authorization.

title: Deep-link constraints
expected: Deep-link rules require eligibility/permission re-check and no duplicate submit.

title: Start finite cycle
steps: Select Start cycle and continue through roles.
expected: Cycle has explicit intro, roles and summary; user explicitly chooses whether to continue.

title: Cycle progress visibility
expected: Finite progress is visible and never suggests infinite scroll.

title: Objective and reason
expected: Objective and factual reason are visible; no inferred mental state.

title: Learn content is not mastery
expected: UI does not mark objective mastered just for viewing explanation.

title: Retrieve answer selection
expected: Selection is visually distinct from submission/canonical result.

title: Wrong first response + retry
steps: Submit wrong answer, then retry correctly.
expected: First wrong is acknowledged; retry is clearly practice and does not rewrite first response.

title: Retry exhausted state
expected: No infinite retry loop; final feedback state is clear.

title: Hint assisted state
expected: UI indicates assistance; copy does not present response as unaided.

title: Skip semantics
steps: Choose Skip for now and confirm.
expected: No completion/mastery/reward is granted in copy; learner can continue safely.

title: Correct feedback tone
expected: Feedback is concise/supportive without mastery overclaim.

title: Transfer step distinction
expected: Transfer changes cue/context and is not labelled as level-up.

title: Cycle summary
expected: Shows practiced evidence/needs review/next step, no fake mastery percentage.

title: Check has no pre-submit hint
expected: Hint action is absent and Check context is explicit.

title: Listening Check policy copy
steps: Inspect play control and condition copy.
expected: Offered play policy can be shown; UI never claims physical listening verification.

title: Placement optional
expected: Learner can continue with provisional/missing evidence state.

title: Placement result uncertainty
expected: Result is provisional and does not claim external CEFR certification.

title: Goal editing
expected: Goal setting is presented as intent, not competence.

title: Locked objective preview
expected: Preview is clearly non-progressing and shows prerequisite reason.

title: No recommendation fallback
expected: A usable curriculum/due/manual action remains; no AI error dead end.

title: Nothing due state
expected: Honest empty/content-gap copy; no fabricated completion.

title: Staff dashboard shell
expected: Operational overview is structured without pretending future data exists.

title: Learner list and detail
expected: List/detail IA works and evidence/activity sections are distinct.

title: No diagnosis language
expected: No mental-state diagnosis or unsupported risk truth is presented.

title: Content lifecycle navigation
steps: Open Library > Draft > Preview > Review > Published examples.
expected: Lifecycle is understandable and revision states are explicit.

title: Draft vs published editability
steps: Compare draft editor and published revision.
expected: Draft is editable; published view offers create-new-draft rather than edit-in-place.

title: Source/license gate
expected: Missing provenance is visibly blocking for publish.

title: Publish confirmation
expected: Copy explains immutable new revision; destructive ambiguity is avoided.

title: Intervention future boundary
expected: Does not imply Phase 11/12 implementation or causal outcome exists.

title: Analytics future boundary
expected: Requires time/source definition and does not display invented production metrics.

title: Administration authorization note
expected: Design never claims sidebar visibility is sufficient authorization.

title: Offline banner
expected: Offline state is visible but non-alarming; available offline actions remain usable.

title: Queued vs synced
steps: Submit/simulate queued action then restore connection.
expected: Copy distinguishes saved on device / waiting to sync / synced.

title: Sync retry failure
expected: Retry is safe and does not encourage duplicate manual submission.

title: Canonical refresh
expected: UI refetches canonical state rather than locally overriding server truth.

title: Media unavailable offline
expected: Valid alternative/sync action shown; no fabricated Check completion.

title: Re-auth state
expected: User is told sign-in is required; local permission bypass is absent.

title: Server authority language
expected: UI does not imply local selection equals canonical scored result.

title: Completion != mastery
expected: Completing a cycle is not labelled mastery/pass unless separate evidence supports it.

title: Skip != completion
expected: No streak/mastery/completion reward copy appears.

title: Assisted != unaided
expected: Assistance remains visible in evidence/feedback semantics.

title: Playback telemetry authority
expected: No statement says client replay count proves clean assessment.

title: Challenge bounded
expected: Challenge does not automatically change level/mastery/unlock.

title: Focus/prerequisite
expected: Prerequisite reason is clear and cannot be bypassed by preference.

title: Qualitative evidence
expected: No fake mastery percentage or diagnosis.

title: Streak separate from learning evidence
expected: Streak is engagement and not shown as skill/mastery.

title: Rewards non-authoritative
expected: Rewards do not alter mastery/prerequisite/Check semantics.

title: Recommendation reason truthful
expected: Displayed reason matches defined reason category; no invented psychological cause.

title: Immutable revision UX
expected: No direct edit-in-place; new draft/revision workflow.

title: Lifecycle separation
expected: Decision/exposure/execution/outcome are not conflated.

title: ML-disabled fallback
expected: Usable deterministic/manual learning flow remains.

title: Keyboard navigation staff
expected: All primary navigation/actions reachable with visible focus.

title: Focus order learner
expected: Focus order follows visual/semantic order.

title: Touch targets
expected: Primary tap targets meet 48dp target; no critical tiny icon-only action.

title: Contrast
expected: Target WCAG 2.2 AA contrast; semantic color never sole signal.

title: Text scaling
steps: Simulate 200% browser text zoom as proxy.
expected: Critical copy/actions remain readable without overlap/loss.

title: Reduced motion
expected: Non-essential motion can be disabled/reduced.

title: Screen-reader names
expected: Controls have meaningful labels/aria where needed.

title: Error identification
expected: Error is communicated by text/icon, not red color alone.

title: Learner small width
expected: No horizontal overflow; primary actions visible.

title: Learner large phone
expected: Layout remains bounded/readable; no excessive line length.

title: Staff desktop
expected: Sidebar/content widths usable; tables readable.

title: Staff compact laptop
expected: Sidebar can compact; core task remains usable.

title: Developer handoff completeness
steps: Check routes, screen IDs, tokens, states, traceability and deferred boundaries.
expected: Developer can implement Phase 3–5 UI without inventing missing interaction semantics.

title: Token source
expected: Named tokens match; implementation can consume stable semantic names.

title: Test ID guidance
expected: Recommended data-testid keys are stable and derived from screen/component IDs.

title: No production code claim
expected: Prototype clearly labelled non-production and contains no backend business implementation.

title: QA package signoff fields
expected: QC, QA, Product/Owner and Tech Lead fields exist with exit criteria.

title: Required-response steps reject blank submit
pre: Review/Transfer/Check item displayed with no option selected
steps: Attempt Submit / Submit and continue / Submit Check without selecting an answer.
expected: Submit is disabled or accessible validation prevents progression; explicit Skip is the only no-answer path where offered; no completion/evidence is fabricated.

title: Representative Grammar flow is executable
steps: Open Grammar cycle → Review → Learn scaffold → Retrieve/hint → Transfer → independent Check.
expected: am/is/are scaffold and all interaction states are concrete; assisted remains assisted; Check has no hint and no blank progression.

title: Representative Listening flow is executable
steps: Open Listening cycle; inspect practice playback, Check play limit, offline media unavailable state and completion behavior.
expected: Playback policy/telemetry wording is concrete; Check offers at most configured plays; offline missing media blocks safely; no physical-listening claim.

title: Content publish lifecycle is executable end to end
pre: Draft content with provenance issue exists
steps: Edit draft → preview → submit review → resolve provenance → approve → confirm publish → inspect immutable published revision → create new draft.
expected: Every transition works; publish confirmation explains immutability; published revision has no direct edit and new change starts a draft.

title: Critical form fields have programmatic accessible names
pre: Staff Content editor and Source/License open
steps: Inspect accessibility tree/name computation for Prompt, answer, source/license and other critical inputs.
expected: Each form control has a stable programmatic name through native label association or equivalent semantics.

title: Gate-critical Screen/State → QA mapping is explicit
pre: Screen inventory, state catalog and QA suite available
steps: Inspect SCREEN_STATE_QA_TRACEABILITY.csv and trace representative gate-critical screen states.
expected: Every inventory screen is explicitly marked gate-critical or supporting-only and maps to QA cases; gate-critical states have test references without inference.

title: Restored connectivity does not equal server-confirmed sync
pre: A durable command is locally queued while offline
steps: Restore network but do not simulate server acknowledgement; inspect Summary and Sync status.
expected: State remains queued/syncing/retryable as appropriate; Synced appears only after explicit authoritative acknowledgement/canonical refresh.
